output_list.reason: The 'mintToken' function has an integer overflow attack vulnerability. When 'mintedAmount' is a large number, the 'totalSupply' += 'mintedAmount' operation will cause integer overflow and set 'totalSupply' to a negative value, aka 'burn' your token balance.

The 'burn' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When 'balanceOf[msg.sender]' is a large number, the _value += 'balanceOf[msg.sender]' operation will cause integer overflow and set 'totalSupply' to a negative value, aka 'burn' your token balance.

The 'burnFrom' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When '_value' is a large number, the _value += 'allowance[_from][msg.sender]' operation will cause integer overflow and set 'totalSupply' to a negative value, aka 'burn' your token balance.

The 'transfer' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When 'balanceOf[_from]' is a large number, the _value += 'balanceOf[_to]' operation will cause integer overflow and set 'balanceOf[_from]' to a negative value, aka 'burn' your token balance.
